propositions: Write-op inputs (force, reason, caused_by, ref, close_class) are hand-mirrored across three adapters (lib, CLI, MCP) with no mechanical enforcement, allowing silent parameter drift to go undetected.
A conformance oracle test suite executes a single shared contract table of (op, inputs, expected outcome) rows against all three adapters to detect behavioral divergences and parameter non-exposure.
Runtime conditional rules (close_class required, reason required for REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES) must be asserted behaviorally and refuse consistently across all adapters.

MCP parameter gaps (force/reason/caused_by/ref not exposed on transition_ticket/claim_ticket inputSchema) are encoded as strict-xfail rows citing scratchy-leprous-galago, turning green when the gap is closed.
Adapter-bound internals (source, return_alias, _creation_channel, repo_root) must not register as false divergences in the oracle.
The suite reuses and extends the existing tests/interfaces/adapters.py three-adapter harness (Adapter protocol, LibraryAdapter, CliAdapter, McpAdapter) without building fresh parallel drivers.
